授業概要
共有結合を，さらに古典論で理解できる結合を，さらに大きな応用として匂いセンサと味覚センサを学ぶ．
This lecture provides covalent bond, and classic-theory-type bonds. Novel technologies such as smell
and taste sensors are also explained.
